::: {.callout-caution title="Status of web site"}
These web pages are placeholders for a planned revision of this site beginning in late 2026. The goal of the site is to document the Homer Multitext project's archive at [https://github.com/homermultitext/hmt-archive](https://github.com/homermultitext/hmt-archive).

Each page includes a publication date, so you can see which parts of the site have been updated when.
:::
